info.title: Stellar Planner API
info.description: REST API of a self-hosted Stellar Planner instance. Sign in with `POST /auth/pin` and send the returned access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; it is forwarded to Supabase, so row-level security applies. Errors are `{ error: { code, message } }`. List endpoints accept `updated_since` and return `deleted_ids` for delta sync.

get.description: Public. Returns the Supabase URL and anon key a client needs for Realtime.

post.description: Rate limited; repeated failures lock sign-in for a growing interval (`423 locked`). Extension and iOS clients receive `session`; the web app receives httpOnly cookies instead.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 instant. Returns only rows changed after it, plus `deleted_ids` removed after it. Pass the previous response's `server_time`.

post.description: Send your own `id` to make retries idempotent.

delete.description: Soft delete: the row is kept for 30 days, then purged.

post.description: Send the moved rows with their new fractional `sort_order` (between the ranks of the new neighbours).

get.description: Without `view`: every live task, or the changes since `updated_since`. With `view`: filtered and ordered like the app's Tasks screen (`today` includes overdue).
